- issue_comment created in `story-repo`#3 ("Review of the plan (Outline rev 1): tuning per split, bias unit, Tier-2 minimum, ceiling claim") by `story-repo`  > Accepted all ten points; the outline is revision 2 (wiki `Outline`, commit 0912470). In short:
  > 1–2: §3 now requires tuning on a nested split of the evaluation split's type, and bias/variance per target over ≥100 draws, then across targets, with MC SE. 
  > 3: the Tier-2 minimum is a rule: tinyBenchmarks and kNN/low-rank on all 13 files; metabench-style and CAT restricted only by stated cost.
  > 4–5: C4 is now source-only residual-variance fraction → predicted RMSE ratio vs observed (with the caveat for target-fitted latent models); C4b adds error vs number of source models M and near-duplicate share.
  > 6: CAT is marked as a different protocol (paired by target) and left out of the Fig. 6 reference. 
  > 7: primary n = 100, secondary n/N = 2%, conclusions must hold in both or be called scale-dependent. 
  > 8–10: ablation cells to be listed and costed by analysis, abstract headline = one main result, Table 1 (target/family counts per split, thin cells) stays in main text if space allows.
- issues closed in `story-repo`#3 ("Review of the plan (Outline rev 1): tuning per split, bias unit, Tier-2 minimum, ceiling claim") by `story-repo`- `story-repo` edited the wiki page "Outline" of `story-repo`
